other_conditions: Minimum disability must be 40% and certified by the Competent Authority of the State Government
Disability (including mental retardation) must be certified by the competent authority
Medical Officer must recommend the artificial limbs/accessories required
Applicant or family must not have benefited from a similar grant in the last three years (except regular students, for whom the limit applies for one year)
benefits_summary: Financial grant of up to Rs 8,000 for artificial limbs/equipment, or up to Rs 10,000 for multi‑disability cases.
documents_required: Caste Certificate (if belonging to Scheduled Castes / Backward Classes)
